newsitem.title: CHILE: Adopted son confesses to Chile diplomat's murder.
newsitem.headline: Adopted son confesses to Chile diplomat's murder.

text.p: A Brazilian man has confessed to murdering his adoptive father, Chilean diplomat Eduardo Vega, whose body was found in Haiti last month, La Tercera newspaper said on Friday.

The paper quoted Haitian police sources as saying Theofilo Bezerra, 30, confessed to killing Vega, whose charred body was discovered in a burned-out car in Port-au-Prince on Feb. 18. The report followed a statement from Chile's foreign ministry on Thursday that Bezerra had been arrested as the main suspect.
"The information is confirmed and that's all I can say," a Haitian police spokesman said.

The foreign ministry has lifted the diplomatic status Bezerra enjoyed as a result of his family ties with the 57-year-old unmarried Vega. Pressed for details on how Vega was able to adopt Bezerra two years ago, Foreign Minister Jose Miguel Insulza said, "We can't interfere in people's private lives and prevent them from acting according to the law."
Vega's body may be repatriated to Chile if his family asks that it be returned, although there could be delays if a second autopsy is needed, Insulza said.
